info.name: Drawbridge · Veradigm certification (Oct 26, 2026)
info.description:
Every Unity action in the API Assessment (rev Oct 22), grouped as on page 7: Veradigm PM, then Veradigm EHR.

1. Import the environment **Drawbridge-Certification** and fill in the four empty values (service user, service password, app name, EHR user and password) from the password manager. Never save them in this file.
2. Run **1. Sign in**, then any folder. Requests chain: GetPatientDemographics saves the MRN for GetPatientByMRN, GetScheduleByPatientID saves an appointment ID, GetDocuments saves a document ID.
3. Folders 5 and 8 are WRITES on the sandbox. Run them only when Veradigm QA asks.
4. Finish with **10. Sign out**.

Synthetic test patient: Teodoro Brightwater (PM 51389, Veradigm EHR 81069). No real patient data.

item.name: 9. Drawbridge on AWS

request.description: Needs the tool key.
Verifies the caller the way the phone agent does (Veradigm PM and EHR, MRN matching). Same call ID across requests: the patient is verified once per call.
Upcoming appointments of the verified patient. Same call ID across requests: the patient is verified once per call.
Balance of the verified patient. Same call ID across requests: the patient is verified once per call.
Insurance on file for the verified patient. Same call ID across requests: the patient is verified once per call.

item.description: The phone agent's route on AWS. Header x-drawbridge-key: the agent key (tool key for /tools). Run 'Verify patient' first in the same call.

request.description: Ends the session at the end of testing.
Ends the session at the end of testing.

exec: const d = new Date(); const mdy = x => `${pad(x.getMonth() + 1)}/${pad(x.getDate())}/${x.getFullYear()}`;
if (!pm.environment.get('changed_since')) { const s = new Date(d); s.setDate(s.getDate() - 7); pm.environment.set('changed_since', mdy(s)); }
